name: Autosomal Recessive Alport Syndrome

criteria.description: Consanguineous parents or siblings affected with similar renal disease
Electron microscopy showing characteristic glomerular basement membrane abnormalities (thinning, thickening, lamellation)
Identification of biallelic pathogenic variants in COL4A3 or COL4A4 genes
Presence of persistent hematuria and progressive proteinuria
Sensorineural hearing loss and ocular abnormalities consistent with Alport syndrome

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of characteristic renal biopsy findings or biallelic pathogenic variants in COL4A3/COL4A4 genes plus persistent hematuria
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing is increasingly used to confirm diagnosis and differentiate from other hereditary nephropathies.

searchTerms: blood in urine visible only under microscope
tiny amounts of blood in urine

pathognomonic.symptomName: Characteristic glomerular basement membrane ultrastructural abnormalities

common.symptomName: Hypertension secondary to chronic kidney disease
searchTerms: high blood pressure from kidney disease
hypertension due to chronic kidney damage

occasional.symptomName: Progressive chronic kidney disease leading to end-stage renal disease
Fatigue related to anemia of chronic kidney disease
searchTerms: fatigue due to low red blood cells

rare.symptomName: Leiomyomatosis of esophagus or tracheobronchial tree
rare.notes: Rarely associated with COL4A5 mutations but reported in some AR cases
searchTerms: smooth muscle tumors in esophagus or airway
leiomyoma in esophagus or bronchial tubes
nerve issues caused by kidney toxins

laboratory: Proteinuria detected by urine protein quantification
Elevated serum creatinine and blood urea nitrogen in progressive disease
imaging: Electron microscopy of renal biopsy showing GBM lamellation, thinning, and thickening
Ophthalmologic slit-lamp examination revealing anterior lenticonus
other: Audiometry demonstrating bilateral sensorineural hearing loss

distinguishingFeatures: Isolated hematuria without progression to renal failure

redFlags: Rapid progression to end-stage renal disease in childhood
Bilateral sensorineural hearing loss onset before adolescence
Presence of anterior lenticonus on ophthalmologic exam
references: Kashtan CE. Alport syndrome: Achieving clarity on the genetic and clinical spectrum. Kidney Int. 2021;99(3):567-569.
Savige J, et al. Expert guidelines for the management of Alport syndrome and thin basement membrane nephropathy. Nat Rev Nephrol. 2019;15(10):615-630.
